longLivedAssets.label: Long-lived assets
longLivedAssets.definition: Right-of-use assets and furniture, equipment and leasehold improvements, net, held in the United States; no individual foreign country was more than 10% of the total.

source.label: FY2024 Form 10-K, Note 19, Segment Reporting, geographic information
source.quote: As of December 31, 2024 and 2023, Blackstone held long-lived assets in the United States of $ 1.1 billion.

notes: Blackstone's own footprint is small (about 4,895 employees at its New York headquarters and around the world, per the FY2024 10-K); it publishes no state- or country-level employee, office or tax breakdown. Its wider economic reach runs through portfolio companies, but no state-by-state portfolio data was found on blackstone.com, and portfolio-company data would not be Blackstone's own footprint. The only country value in the 10-K is U.S. long-lived assets ($1.1bn); no foreign country exceeded 10%. Sites are the headquarters and the leased offices the 10-K names.
